reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the documented yield strength plateau (P4) and the emerging edge-dislocation control mechanism (P14, P16) by proposing that local chemical disorder, tunable via cooling rate, governs a temperature-triggered slip mode transition. No single passage proposes this controlled comparison of disorder states to test the mechanism, nor does any passage link processing-induced short-range order to the suppression of the plateau through a change in dislocation character.

edge dislocation control of strength in BCC HEAs (P14, P16, P20, P25, P32)
